verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted SaaS API that receives user URLs, cookies and uploaded documents, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no training-use policy, opt-out setting, data-retention or zero-retention terms. A self-hostable open-source image exists, but nothing in the evidence ties it to preventing data from being used to train AI models, so it is not credited here.
